terminal_verdict_contract.best_effort_teardown: Stop and verify composite before bootstrap; continue cleanup after member failure. Any killpg, wait, /proc snapshot, or final process-group inspection uncertainty is unverified and FAIL, never clean.

terminal_verdict_contract.finalization_behavior: Verdict failures are represented as terminal FAIL records and do not raise FINAL_RECORD_INTERNAL_INCONSISTENCY. terminal_verdict_contract.signal_handler: Install before pre-acquire checks and guard acquisition. SIGTERM before acquisition records a pre-acquire failure without claiming consumption. Block SIGTERM only over guard mutation/handoff with pthread_sigmask, mark the acquired state before unblocking, then route any pending signal into consumed FAIL handling. During campaign SIGTERM raises RUNNER_INTERRUPTED_BY_SIGNAL:SIGTERM; during teardown/finalization it latches without throwing, forces FAIL resynchronization through handler restoration, and the previous handler is restored exactly once.
